description: This file defines the RecyclerView adapter 'ReceiptsListAdapter' and its associated ViewHolder 'JobsHolder' for displaying a list of receipts in an Android application. It manages creating view holders, binding receipt data to views, and sanitizing receipt type and amount strings.

classes.name: ReceiptsListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying receipt items in a RecyclerView, managing view creation and data binding.

classes.name: JobsHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to views for each receipt item in the RecyclerView.

methods.name: ReceiptsListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of receipts.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder object for a receipt item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds receipt data to the views in the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of receipt items.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input strings by replacing 'null' or null with an empty string.

methods.name: JobsHolder
methods.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to UI components of a receipt list item.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on receipt items (currently empty).
